classification.difficultyReason: Read the graph's zero locations and compare them with the possible input range of cosine to explain why composition cannot give zero.

answer.short: All zeros of $f$ lie outside $[-1,1]$, but $\cos\theta\in[-1,1]$. Therefore there are no solutions.
answer.worked: From the graph, $f(x)$ has no zero for $-1\le x\le1$. Since $-1\le\cos\theta\le1$, the input $\cos\theta$ cannot equal any zero of $f$. Hence $f(\cos\theta)=0$ has no solutions.
